- Dawn (Pakistan), South China Morning Post - China, 8 hours ago: China calls for Middle East dialogue in talks with Iran, Saudi Arabia, Oman.
China stepped up diplomatic efforts on Monday to resolve the Middle East crisis, urging a return to the negotiating table in back-to-back meetings with Iranian, Omani and Saudi officials in Beijing. The meetings come days after United States President Donald Trump issued a fresh war threat more than eight months into the conflict, which was triggered by US-Israeli strikes on Iran and has at times spilled over into neighbouring countries.

- Dawn (Pakistan), 10 hours ago: Civilian convicted of offences against state cannot claim fundamental rights, govt says in report to LHC.
LAHORE: The Punjab government on Monday informed the Lahore High Court (LHC) that a civilian who commits an offence against the state and is convicted cannot claim the protection of fundamental rights. The response came as the government sought the dismissal of a petition filed by Barrister Hassaan Khan Niazi, nephew of PTI founder Imran Khan, challenging his handover to the army and subsequent trial in a case related to the May 9 riots.
- Dawn (Pakistan), NDTV - Top Stories, Jerusalem Post, South China Morning Post - China, Politico Europe, 3 hours ago: Fridge cyberattack hits supermarkets across Europe.
Grocery stores in at least five European countries saw temperatures in their cold cases soar on Monday, with several confirming they had been hit by a cyberattack similar to one three weeks ago in France. Supermarkets in Belgium, Estonia, Finland, Luxembourg and Sweden were among those affected in the latest hacker attack. Major French retailers said on Oct 12 that hundreds of store refrigeration systems were hit by a cyberattack, which forced them to throw out spoiled food and raised concerns about food security. No one has claimed responsibility for either attack.
